thesis: HOUSE is the place you return to, not a device dashboard: selected locus -> prepare -> set out -> return with evidence -> service -> ready.

owners.loadout: BODY / FIT kits, fittings, active session, route-friction projection and RETURN/PATINA

inventory_law.inventory: exact instances believed/observed to exist with source and last-known address; not created by HOMEBASE
inventory_law.fixture: capability whose useful identity is spatially bound unless explicitly moved/released
inventory_law.loadout: temporary references to source-owned instances for one purpose; BODY / FIT owns the kit/session
inventory_law.service: returned discrepancy/residue supported by evidence; silence never implies READY

NO SCORE / QUEST QUEUE / STREAK / COMPLETION PERCENTAGE

proof_gate: One existing BODY/FIT loadout can retain one HOUSE address through PREP -> explicit SET OUT Dayline handoff -> BODY/FIT RETURN while HOMEBASE reads the same source-owned session/receipt without copying canonical item state.
stop: Do not add a general inventory manager or free-roaming house game. Extend only for a real source-owned object/service/loadout seam that this projection cannot express.
